thread:
Maya (CS): Quick debrief from today's Glimmer Health onboarding call — pulled out the feature asks and a few pain signals. Copying the product folks.
Maya (CS): Top items: 1) 'per-route billing toggle' request (they want to turn off embeddings for search during pilot). 2) Export of end-user prompt + model response for audit. 3) Confusing default retry behavior causing duplicated responses.
Priya (CS Lead): Strong renewal signal attached to this account — they're on a tight compliance timeline, these audit exports are blocking legal sign-off.
Rafael (PM): Thanks — can you paste the exact wording they used for the export ask? Is it 'whole request/response log' or just sanitized transcripts?
Maya (CS): Quote from customer: "We need an auditable CSV of prompt+response per chat turn, with user id and timestamp — sanitized option is okay but must include model id & confidence if possible."
Clara (UX): Noted. UX question: do they need anything structured (e.g., separate columns for function calls / tool outputs)?
Maya (CS): They said some calls include structured outputs; they'd like those preserved as JSON in a column rather than flattened.
Jun (Eng): On retries — can you share an example trace? Is this the client-side automatic retry or our platform fallback?
Maya (CS): It's our platform fallback. They saw two responses back-to-back after a perceived timeout during long-generation. They pasted logs but I'll DM you the snippet.
Priya (CS Lead): Prioritization note: legal & renewal risk > usability for them. If PM thinks export is heavy, we should at least provide a stopgap (manual export endpoint / temporary data dump).
Rafael (PM): Quick triage: (A) Compliance export endpoint — High priority (B) Retry behavior audit — Medium (C) Per-route billing toggle — Low-medium for this customer but could be useful generalized product.
Clara (UX): For (A) we could prototype an 'audit export' modal in console that lets CS request a CSV export scoped to date range & route, preserves structured JSON in a cell. Low UI effort, backend export job needed.
Jun (Eng): Backend notes: export job sounds straightforward but needs strict access controls & logs — tie to KMS access audit. ETA for a minimal export job (no UI) ~2w with a small sprint.
Rafael (PM): Can we do a 1-2 week stopgap manual export first? Jun, is a read-only dump via internal admin tool feasible this week?
Jun (Eng): I can scope an internal admin export job for this week — need a quick approval for elevated keys.
Maya (CS): I'll coordinate with customer to accept a temporary NDA for a manual dump if needed.
Priya (CS Lead): Also: request to add a 'renewal blocker' tag on this account in CRM so AMs escalate.
Maya (CS): Done. CRM tag added + flagged for AM follow-up tomorrow.
Rafael (PM): Follow-ups: Jun — DM me the access/ETA. Clara — sketch the console modal (small). Maya/Priya — confirm exact data retention window customer needs. I'll slot the export work into next planning cycle but prioritize remediation for this account.
Maya (CS): Will confirm retention & send the logs to Jun now.
Jun (Eng): Got the logs, thanks. Will start on internal export and post progress here.
Clara (UX): I'll drop a quick mock by EOD.
Priya (CS Lead): Thanks team. If this goes well, we should consider making the export feature a standard part of onboarding for regulated customers.
Maya (CS): Agreed — they'd pay for a packaged compliance export add-on. Worth tracking as monetization signal.
Rafael (PM): Good signal — adding to product notes.
Maya (CS): cc @Jun @Clara @Rafael — will update thread when customer confirms retention window. :thumbsup:
